note: _locum hominis_. The expression does not make sense; it must be: _forma hominis_ (most likely was the underlying Greek τύπος misread as τόπος). Geoltrain.

_nos et patres nostri talibus morbis languemus_ (Clementina) – we and our fathers suffered from such illnesses. The Weber/Gryson edition has _mortalibus moribus egimus_ (have acted according to mortal customs, i.e., have committed mortal sins) and relegates _morbis_ to the apparatus.
